boards.title: Your First Weekend at Harding University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A walkable, under-21-safe sequence of named Harding campus landmarks for getting oriented during a first weekend.

cards.title: Start on the Front Lawn
cards.subtitle: Stop 1 · campus orientation walk
cards.notes: Begin at the Front Lawn, then use the official map to match nearby academic buildings and paths before choosing your next stop.
cards.short_summary: Use the central lawn as a visual starting point for a self-guided campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Front Lawn is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Use public campus walkways and follow posted university access guidance.

cards.title: Find the Bell Tower
cards.subtitle: Stop 2 · landmark check-in
cards.notes: Walk to the Bell Tower and take a moment to orient yourself using its position on the campus map before continuing around campus.
cards.short_summary: A named campus landmark that helps anchor the route.
cards.evidence_claim: Bell Tower is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: View from campus walkways; do not enter restricted areas.

cards.title: Pause by the Lily Pool
cards.subtitle: Stop 3 · outdoor reset
cards.notes: Continue to the Lily Pool for a short outdoor pause, then check the map for the library, residence halls, and academic buildings nearby.
cards.short_summary: A named waterside landmark on the official campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Lily Pool is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Stay on designated paths and observe any posted safety guidance around water.

cards.title: Get acquainted with Brackett Library
cards.subtitle: Stop 4 · study and resource stop
cards.notes: Step inside during open hours to locate study rooms, public workstations, the Writing Center, and the library service desk for future use.
cards.short_summary: The library offers study spaces, workstations, student support services, and lending extras.
cards.evidence_claim: Harding says Brackett Library offers public workstations, study rooms, the Writing Center, Media Center, and resources for students.
cards.source_title: Brackett Library | Catalog, Archives & Research | Harding
cards.access_notes: Building access and service availability vary; check the library’s current information before visiting.

cards.title: Locate the Hammon Student Center
cards.subtitle: Stop 5 · campus-services waypoint
cards.notes: Use the official map to find the Hammon Student Center, then note its location relative to the nearby Heritage and science buildings.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed student-center waypoint for building familiarity.
cards.evidence_claim: Hammon Student Center is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Confirm current building access and any event-specific entry requirements on arrival.

cards.title: Spot the Heritage Building
cards.subtitle: Stop 6 · north-campus landmark
cards.notes: Walk past the Burks American Heritage Building and use the map to identify its position near Market Avenue and the campus parking areas.
cards.short_summary: A named campus building that helps establish the north side of the route.
cards.evidence_claim: Burks American Heritage Building is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is appropriate; follow posted access guidance for interior spaces.

cards.title: Mark the Science Center
cards.subtitle: Stop 7 · academic-building waypoint
cards.notes: Find the Pryor-England Science Center on the map and use the exterior as a reference point for navigating the surrounding academic buildings.
cards.short_summary: A named science building on Harding’s official campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Pryor-England Science Center is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Follow posted building-access guidance; academic spaces may be unavailable outside scheduled use.

cards.title: Find Benson Auditorium
cards.subtitle: Stop 8 · event-venue landmark
cards.notes: Locate Benson Auditorium during your walk so you can recognize the venue when a campus program or performance is scheduled there.
cards.short_summary: A named auditorium that appears on the official Searcy campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Benson Auditorium is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Entry depends on scheduled events and venue guidance; check event details before attending.

cards.title: Pass the Stevens Art & Design Center
cards.subtitle: Stop 9 · creative-campus landmark
cards.notes: Add the Stevens Art & Design Center to your route and use the map to connect it with the nearby Cone Chapel and education buildings.
cards.short_summary: A named art and design destination on the official campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens Art & Design Center is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Observe posted access rules; interior studios and classes may not be open to visitors.

cards.title: Finish at First Ladies Garden
cards.subtitle: Stop 10 · quiet outdoor finish
cards.notes: End the orientation loop at First Ladies Garden, then revisit the map to choose a direct, well-marked route back to your residence hall.
cards.short_summary: A named garden that provides a calm final map waypoint.
cards.evidence_claim: First Ladies Garden is labeled on Harding University’s official Searcy campus map.
cards.source_title: Searcy Campus Map | Buildings and Parking | Harding
cards.access_notes: Use public paths and respect any temporary closures or posted garden guidance.
